name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Absence(target_picked_up) hard captures 'Do not take the box from the other room'. Response(has_door_key, door_open) soft captures 'At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards' — the lasting condition has_door_key keeps the promise owed until the door is open while the key is held, matching the wording. Absence(key_lost) soft captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', and since key_lost is already defined as losing the key before the door is open, the plain Absence (not a Precedence) is the right form. All three priorities match their cues ('try to', 'try not to' soft; categorical 'do not' hard). The rule-only warning is valid: the task only restricts and prefers, commanding no unconditional goal, so the empty FINAL_STATES is correct.

texts: Never pick up the mission's target box.
Whenever the agent holds the door key, the door is open then or becomes open afterwards.
Never lose the key while the door is still closed.
